user.title: Swiss Earthquakes (SED)
user.description: Sets up earthquake tracking (Swiss Seismological Service SED) around a location. Latitude/longitude default to your Home Assistant home location. Add the integration again for a different radius or location.

error.invalid_days: Enter a time window of at least 1 day.
